data.narrative:
Multiply Labs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Fred Parietti and Alice Melocchi, having raised $41M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparative set of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach uses the company's $85M total-raised proxy as a base, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $170M. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because Multiply Labs does not disclose revenue; the three public peers trade at a median 6.6x price-to-sales, but without target revenue this multiple remains inoperable. Peer-Median analysis was similarly inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage private comparables meeting narrow filtering criteria.

The triangulated valuation range is $144M to $195M, with $170M as the central estimate. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than robust triangulation. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of a 2.0x multiplier for this company's specific risk profile and the absence of revenue-based anchoring. Additional diligence on comparable financials and unit economics would strengthen conviction in any specific valuation point within this range.
